scope.title: Evidence Pack for [Project / Claim Name]
scope.description: Gather, validate, and package authoritative evidence to support the stated claim(s) for [Project / Claim Name]. The pack will enable reviewers to verify compliance with requirements and make a go/no-go decision.
objectives: Collect primary source evidence that directly supports each claim stated in the project brief.
Validate authenticity and completeness of collected evidence.
Produce an evidence bundle organized for reviewer verification and archival.
inScope: Identification and collection of documents, logs, screenshots, and photos that substantiate the project claims.
Basic validation of each item (source, date, signer/creator, integrity checks).
Metadata capture for every evidence item (filename, filetype, author, creation date, hash).
Organization of evidence into a single deliverable structure with an index and summary.
outOfScope: Deep forensic analysis beyond basic authenticity checks.
Legal review or formal notarization of documents (unless explicitly requested).
Long-term archival beyond delivering the evidence pack to stakeholders.
acceptanceCriteria: Each claim is mapped to one or more evidence items in the index.
Evidence items include complete metadata (source, date, author, checksum).
No missing required evidence for critical claims as defined by the requester.
Pack includes an index and a 1-page executive summary of findings.
constraints: All evidence must be collected from existing sources; no new testing or instrumentation unless approved.
Sensitive data redaction will be performed per requester's instructions prior to delivery.
Delivery format is a single compressed archive (ZIP) plus an index file (JSON).
deliverables: Evidence archive (ZIP) containing all evidence items
Index file (index.json) listing items, metadata, and claim mappings
Validation report (validation.json) with checksums and basic authenticity notes
